answer: Voting power can follow a river of capped endorsements from a small trusted seed set. Each endorsement carries a fixed share, a pearl of voting capacity; an identity's influence is bounded by flow from the seeds. A voyage through thousands of clone accounts cannot increase capacity across the cut separating them from honest agents. Attackers must obtain additional scarce endorsements from honest members to gain weight. This limits fake-account influence only if the seeds and endorsement budgets remain trustworthy.
